entities.summary: Eudócia Maria Holanda de Araújo Caldas is a Brazilian physician, military police officer, and politician. Affiliated with the Liberal Party (PL), she has been a senator for Alagoas since the resignation of Rodrigo Cunha (Podemos-AL) in December 2024.
